apiVersion.description: APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.

kind.description: Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.

spec.description: AMIdentityProviderSpec defines the desired state of an AM identity provider.

configuration.description: Configuration Plugin-specific configuration as a JSON-encoded string.

domainWhitelist.description: DomainWhitelist Email domains allowed to authenticate through this identity provider.

groupMapper.description: GroupMapper Group mapper: assigns AM groups based on provider attribute values.

mappers.description:
Mappers Attribute mappers: maps provider claims to AM user profile attributes.
Defaults to {}.

name.description: Name Human-readable name of the identity provider.

roleMapper.description: RoleMapper Role mapper: assigns AM roles based on provider attribute values.

system.description: System Whether this is the domain's system identity provider. Immutable after creation.

type.description: Type Identity provider plugin type identifier. Immutable after creation.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: name, type and configuration are required unless system is true

status.description: AMIdentityProviderStatus defines the observed state of an AM identity provider.

conditions.description: Conditions describe the current conditions of the security domain.

items.description: Condition contains details for one aspect of the current state of this API Resource.

lastTransitionTime.description: lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.

message.description: message is a human readable message indicating details about the transition.

observedGeneration.description: observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon.

reason.description: reason contains a programmatic identifier indicating the reason for the condition's last transition.

status.description: status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown.

type.description: type of condition in CamelCase or in foo.example.com/CamelCase.

environmentId.description: The environment Key defined in the AM context.

key.description: The Key of the security domain in the AM instance.

name.description: The name of the identity provider in AM. For the system identity provider, the one AM builds.

organizationId.description: The organization Key defined in the AM context.

type.description: The plugin type of the identity provider in AM. For the system identity provider, the one AM builds.
